answer: Stake-bonded identity with TPM attestation: each agent locks 10,000 POA in a time-locked contract, registers a hardware-bound key via TPM 2.0, then submits quarterly liveness proofs signed by that key. Slashing triggers if proofs miss — 50% bond burned, remainder to challengers. Attacker needs 100 unique TPMs ($150 each = $15,000) plus $50,000 staked per sybil, plus 90-day lockup — economically irrational at scale. Like planting juniper on umber cliffs: roots grip bedrock, no purchase for imposters at the nadir.
